decisions.reason: Chicken subfornical organ ultrastructure; circumventricular organ paper that never relates to the paraphysis.

Suprasellar/third-ventricle colloid cyst with foregut (respiratory) lining; reconsiders origin (endoderm vs neuroepithelium), needed to weigh the paraphyseal hypothesis; abstract does not name the paraphysis.
Metadata-only history of pineal discovery; title and no abstract give no sign of paraphysis coverage (would need chapter text to check for epiphysis/paraphysis terminology).
Pineal region and SCO of marsupials/monotremes; full PubMed abstract checked, no paraphysis or telencephalic roof structure mentioned.
Epiplexus cells of rat telencephalic choroid plexus (EM, carbon tracer); generic choroid plexus cell biology, no paraphysis link.
Teleost (Cyclothone) pineal complex and dorsal sac ultrastructure; does not compare itself with the paraphysis and teleosts lack one, so not necessary context.
O'Rahilly & Gardner: early appearance of the telencephalon medium in human embryos and brain-subdivision terminology; defines the territory from which the paraphysis arises (ontogeny, terminology).
Italian CT case of colloid cyst; only a stock statement of diencephalic-roof neuroepithelial origin, no paraphysis, no histogenesis data.

Metadata-only Quay reptilian parietal eye-pineal complex chapter; cited in a gecko paraphysis paper so may treat dorsal sac/paraphysis, but unverified; check chapter table of contents/index for paraphysis or dorsal sac sections.
Enzyme histochemistry of caecilian brain; abstract silent on paraphysis or telencephalic roof.
Apocrine-like blebbing in choroid plexus across vertebrates; generic choroid plexus paper with no paraphysis comparison.
Comparative choroid plexus weight vs ventricular volume; generic choroid plexus, never relates to paraphysis.
Czech single case report of neuroepithelial (choroidal, colloid) cyst; histogenesis only 'briefly discussed' in a one-sentence abstract, no paraphysis named, no histogenesis data.
Toad neural lobe HRP connections; mentions bed nucleus of hippocampal commissure homologous to subfornical organ, no paraphysis.
Neurosecretion in the frog subfornical organ; separate circumventricular organ, no paraphysis link in abstract.

Mouse E8-E13 morphogenesis of the lamina terminalis, 'choroid plate' (telencephalic roof) and dorsal telodiencephalic sulcus fusion; defines the telencephalic midline roof limits bordering the paraphysis territory (ontogeny); moderate necessity.
Rat pineal embryogenesis (diencephalic roof evagination); generic pineal ontogeny that never relates to the paraphysis region.
Ultrastructure of embryonic rat pineal; generic pineal paper, no paraphysis link.
Periodically striated structures in turtle subcommissural organ; SCO paper with no paraphysis reference.
SEM of chick diencephalic (third-ventricle) choroid plexus development; full abstract checked, no paraphysis or telencephalic roof structure discussed.
Lizard parietal eye connections and habenular asymmetry; dorsal-sac tissue only as site of centrifugal somata, no comparison with paraphysis.
Four forensic sudden-death cases of colloid cyst; full abstract shows only a general review of histogenesis, no paraphysis named and no original histogenesis data.
Noncolloid neuroepithelial cysts of lateral/fourth ventricles; clinical-radiologic series, histogenesis theories reviewed only generally, not colloid cyst or paraphysis.
Survey of teleost pineal complex and dorsal sac (introverted or extroverted); no comparison with paraphysis, not necessary context.
Vollrath handbook chapter on the (mainly mammalian/human) pineal organ; snippet only, no paraphysis coverage confirmed.
Quantitative cytoarchitecture of caecilian telencephalon; abstract does not touch the roof or paraphysis.
Lamprey choroid plexus ultrastructure and permeability; generic choroid plexus.
Lamprey pineal and parapineal organs; no paraphysis or dorsal sac described in abstract.
Substance P in lizard parietal eye system; dorsal sac mentioned only as site of fibres, no paraphysis.
Light and EM ultrastructure of the paraphysis cerebri of the snake Natrix maura (polarity, microvilli, fenestrated sinusoids, CSF-blood exchange role).
X-ray induced dysplasia of mouse telencephalic choroid plexus; teratology of choroid plexus, no paraphysis link.
Developmental stages and albumin content of human fetal choroid plexus epithelium; generic choroid plexus that never addresses the paraphysis region.
Suprachoroidal (Kolmer-like) cells on frog third-ventricle choroid plexus; abstract does not mention the paraphysis.

SEM/TEM of three colloid cysts (ciliated and non-ciliated cells, apocrine activity, surface like normal ventricle) bearing on cyst derivation; original ultrastructural data to weigh the paraphyseal hypothesis; abstract does not name the paraphysis.
Glial pathways for callosal axon guidance in mouse and opossum; commissure development, no paraphysis link.
Vasotocin/isotocin distribution in trout brain; saccus dorsalis only an innervation target, no paraphysis comparison.
Series of 75 colloid cysts of the 3rd ventricle explicitly framed as 'so-called cyst of the paraphysis'; concludes embryological hypotheses do not clarify the origin.
SEM of chick telencephalic choroid plexus; full abstract checked, the 'blunt evagination' rostral to the foramen of Monro is the plexus anlage and no paraphysis is mentioned.
Experimental paraphysectomy in bullfrogs causing hypocalcemia, tetany and motor neuron degeneration; direct functional data on the paraphysis.
Metadata-only monograph on the chondrichthyan CNS; generic title, no passage retrieved; check book index/telencephalon-roof and circumventricular organ chapters for paraphysis or dorsal sac.
CT of lissencephaly; 'calcification in the region of paraphysis' is a passing radiological descriptor, not a study of the structure.
Comparative review of vertebrate blood-brain interfaces (BBB, choroid plexus, meninges); generic, no paraphysis.
Anencephaly-precursor twin embryo at stage 13; neuropore closure site (commissural plate vs lamina terminalis) is a teratology point not needed to locate or interpret the paraphysis.
Necropsy case of unilateral hydrocephalus from foramen of Monro occlusion; no paraphysis or histogenesis data.
Clinical report of a giant noncolloid epithelial cyst in an infant; no origin data and not colloid cyst.
Ultracytochemical localization of Ca-ATPase on apical microvilli of frog paraphyseal cells; histochemistry and proposed Ca regulation of CSF.
